title: Frontend: Product Rating Heatmap
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Product Rating Heatmap. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App({values=[[0,2],[4,1]]}). Render a table of td cells, text=value and data-level=floor(value/globalMax*4), or 0 when global max=0. Null means missing: text - and data-level=missing. Values are a bounded rectangular matrix of nonnegative numbers/null. Include caption Ratings and accessible text rather than color alone.
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Normalize counts using a documented global or per-row scale, since the choice changes interpretation.
alternativeApproaches: Switch between absolute and relative scales and explain how each can mislead comparisons.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: All zeros; one extreme value; missing cells.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
